notes: Flagged unit 23 retained: לְמָעְלָה is rendered by the single adverb exceeding, no morpheme owning a part of it, so preposition, noun and directive he share one unit headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 32).
Both Kohathite and Korahite phrases are rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted and each article takes the the standing before its own word (rule 29).
